notes: Access: shopterrain.com is DataDome-protected per prior pass; this session used Tier-1 HTTP only (curl_cffi, impersonate=chrome116), which succeeded for robots.txt, homepage, /new-arrivals (6 pages), /best-sellers, /sale-home and /sale-garden before DataDome started 403-ing all curl_cffi profiles on a subsequent Clearance sub-page request (see cl214.json/na214.json for that block). No Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome was needed for Bestsellers - it was fully resolved before the block occurred. Navigation discovery: read the site's embedded Pinia state (window.urbnInitialPiniaState) from the homepage HTML, which is the SSR equivalent of the mega-menu - superNav.navItems['shopping-root'] lists all 9 top-level shop categories (New, Halloween, Kitchen+Tabletop, Decor, Outdoor Living, Furniture, Planters+Garden Utility, Candles, Gifts, Sale); none is labelled Bestsellers/Best Sellers/Top Sellers/Popular/Customer Favorites, so it is not part of the primary shop-by-category nav. It was found instead via the site's own search-autocomplete (SAYT) config embedded in the same state: featureConfigSayt.saytConfig has "saytPopularOverride": "best-sellers", "saytPopularOverrideTitle": "Best Selling" - i.e. the site's search layer itself points to a /best-sellers collection. Also checked footer nav (footer key in the same Pinia state) - no Sale/New/Best/Popular/Clearance links there, just generic Help+Info/Company links. Opened https://www.shopterrain.com/best-sellers directly: it is a genuine PLP (pageType="category", categoryId=NEW-FEATURED-BEST-SELLERS, displayName "**Best-Sellers", H1 override "Best-Sellers"), parentSlug="marketing-root" (a marketing/promo nav root rather than the main shopping tree, but still a real product listing, not an editorial page), childSlugs=[] (no further sub-structure - a single undifferentiated listing, no need to invent sub-categories). Page 1 of 1 rendered exactly 11 product tiles with 11 distinct productIds, matching category.totalRecordCount=11 exactly - no colorway-duplicate-tile inflation observed here (colors are a nested facet per tile, not separate tiles, unlike some other listings on this same platform documented in the prior Home-Decor pass). All 11 items are home/garden decor or garden-utility gear except one borderline item, flagged below. Did not check non-English equivalents - shopterrain.com is a US-only, English-only site (confirmed via sites.siteId='tr-us' in the same Pinia state, no locale switcher).
